lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into three distinct horizontal rows posterior to the branchial slits. Centroids within the median row maintain consistent inter-blob spacing, forming a predictable linear sequence along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a lattice-like configuration. These intersections are most prominent in the mid-flank region directly inferior to the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature runs across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side, extending from above the gills toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin's silhouette contains approximately 8-10 high-luminance blobs. The distribution is non-uniform, with larger, more intense clusters located in the ventral-anterior quadrant and smaller, less defined spots near the trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit displays a significantly higher spatial density of lower-diameter, high-luminance spots compared to the lateral flank pattern.
